vetSays.line: A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." Company makes the road shorter.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek came back with 422 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Better close to the fire today.
📋 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (2 sticks now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Juan telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about you. The retelling is already better than the event.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.

A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about something. Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek."
You catch fragments by the fire — Ikram telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
You catch fragments by the fire — Juan telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about Ikram. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
Brian showed A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek the Muscadine Grapes — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
Ikram is showing A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek how to tie a snare. Hands patient. It takes three tries.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek came back with 490 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 245 kcal in, 245 kcal eaten at the fire.
You catch fragments by the fire — Juan telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.

You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms telling A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek about himself. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
Jude showed A man, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek the Pawpaw — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.

🔥 The fire settles. Henry has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still — I put it down today." "Its legs lock. White light wells behind its eyes." "It drops its head — the antlers come around in a short, vicious arc." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ikram says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." the man in his 50s, with a scarred cheek mutters "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
🛡️ Brian, Grayson, Juan and Daniyar met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Brian, Grayson, Juan, Daniyar are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ikram just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Brian, Grayson and Ikram met them at the door — 3 put down. Brian, Grayson, Ikram are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Daniyar just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Hank, Juan, Daniyar, Nikos and Henry met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Juan didn't come back. Hank, Daniyar, Nikos, Henry are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Thabo just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Hank, Ikram, Daniyar, Nikos and Henry met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Hank, Ikram, Daniyar, Nikos, Henry are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Daniyar — Craft 2. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Daniyar chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 2.
🛡️ Chloe, Elijah and Tiaki met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Chloe, Elijah, Tiaki are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Daniyar Askarov, 33 — a paramedic. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Green Whisper, Cold-Blooded, Berserker Rage, Translator.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tiaki just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Yara, Chloe and Tiaki met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Yara, Tiaki are hurt.
